gap_to_26_month_target.bounded_download_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import datetime, pathlib, urllib.request
root = pathlib.Path('/home/quant/quant/quant-edge-lab/data/raw/ARCHIVE_BINANCE_USDM/BTCUSDT')
day, end = datetime.date(2024, 9, 8), datetime.date(2026, 10, 8)
while day <= end:
    for kind, suffix in (('aggTrades', 'aggTrades'), ('markPriceKlines', '1m')):
        out = root / day.isoformat() / f'BTCUSDT-{suffix}-{day}.zip'
        if not out.exists():
            out.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            urllib.request.urlretrieve(f'https://data.binance.vision/data/futures/um/daily/{kind}/BTCUSDT/{out.name}', out)
    day += datetime.timedelta(days=1)
PY
